"""Runtime configuration loaded from environment variables."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_NVIDIA_BASE_URL = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
DEFAULT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:11434/v1"


def _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:
    """Minimal .env loader (no dependency). Existing env vars take precedence."""
    if not path.is_file():
        return
    for raw in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Settings:
    env: str
    log_level: str
    data_dir: Path
    nvidia_base_url: str = DEFAULT_NVIDIA_BASE_URL
    ollama_base_url: str = DEFAULT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
    # Secret: excluded from repr so it never ends up in logs or tracebacks.
    nvidia_api_key: str | None = field(default=None, repr=False)

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls, dotenv: Path | None = Path(".env")) -> Settings:
        if dotenv is not None:
            _load_dotenv(dotenv)
        return cls(
            env=os.getenv("APP_ENV", "dev"),
            log_level=os.getenv("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"),
            data_dir=Path(os.getenv("DATA_DIR", "data")),
            nvidia_base_url=os.getenv("NVIDIA_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_NVIDIA_BASE_URL).rstrip("/"),
            ollama_base_url=os.getenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", DEFAULT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL).rstrip("/"),
            nvidia_api_key=os.getenv("NVIDIA_API_KEY") or None,
        )

    import argparse

    from nvidia_ai.config import Settings

    def positive(v: str) -> int:
        n = int(v)
        if n < 1:
            raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError("must be >= 1")
        return n

    pair_labels = [p.label for p in PAIRS]
    prompt_ids = [p.id for p in PROMPTS]
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="nvidia-ai bench", description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--pairs", nargs="+", default=pair_labels, choices=pair_labels)
    ap.add_argument("--providers", nargs="+", default=list(PROVIDERS), choices=PROVIDERS)
    ap.add_argument("--prompts", nargs="+", default=prompt_ids, choices=prompt_ids)
    ap.add_argument("--runs", type=positive, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=positive, default=512)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("local/benchmarks"))
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    s = Settings.from_env()
    endpoints: dict[str, Endpoint] = {}
    if "nvidia" in args.providers:
        if not s.nvidia_api_key:
            ap.error("NVIDIA_API_KEY not set (.env)")
        endpoints["nvidia"] = Endpoint("nvidia", s.nvidia_base_url, s.nvidia_api_key)
